simplification.method: Preserve source triangles inside the 0.051 m vertical scoring cylinder per FLOWER instance; simplify only exterior triangles.

measuredSurfaceValidation.method: bidirectional deterministic source/candidate triangle-centroid samples, point-to-triangle distance

functionalOpeningValidation.method: 65 vertical rays through the 2.79-inch POLLEN disk at every Layer C/B/X instance, plus 16 scoring-radius occupancy rays

finiteBallContactValidation.method: Rapier finite-sphere intersectsShape grid around each source Layer C/B/X surface; centers constrained to fit within the official 4-inch scoring radius; 2.5 mm spatial steps and 16 angles

claims: The protected scoring region passed the measured functional gates.
The candidate is simplified outside that protected region.
The candidate is not an exact whole-mesh copy of the source.
